examples.arabic: أنا بجمع آراء كل صحابي قبل ما أعمل اي تصويت على الديكور
examples.english: I gather opinions from all my friends before I make any vote on the decor.
examples.transliteration: Ana bagmaʿ ārāʾ koll ṣoḥāby ʾabl ma aʿmel ayy taṣwīt ʿala el-dīkōr.

examples.arabic: انا بست ايدها قبل ما امشي
examples.english: I kissed her hand before I left.
examples.transliteration: ana bost edha abl ma amshy

examples.arabic: ما عرفتش مين ده في الاول علشان شكله اتغير قبل ما يقرب مني
examples.english: I did not know who this was at first because his appearance changed before he got closer to me.
examples.transliteration: ma araftesh meen da fel awal alashan shaklo etghayar abl ma yearab meny

examples.arabic: انا عايز قهوة كبيرة و اكل بسرعة قبل الشغل
examples.english: I want a big coffee and food quickly before work
examples.transliteration: Ana ayaz ahwa kebeera w akl besor'a abel el shoghl

examples.arabic: وكلهم قالوا مع السلامة قبل ما يمشوا وهما مبسوطين
examples.english: And they all said "Goodbye" before they left, feeling happy.
examples.transliteration: Wa kulluhum qālū maʿa salāma qabl mā yimshū wa huma mabsuṭīn.

examples.english: There isn't much time before work.
